statement.zh: 爱琴绝对年代「高/低年代」方案（含喷发日历年）仍未共识；本库不把单一日历年写成定论。
statement.en: Aegean absolute ‘high/low’ chronology schemes (including eruption calendar years) lack consensus; this library does not treat a single calendar year as settled fact.
